result.instructions: Tools for RotaCloud, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes RotaCloud data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run rotacloud_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run rotacloud_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run rotacloud_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. rotacloud_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: rotacloud_list_accounts
tools.title: List accounts
tools.description: The RotaCloud account(s) this API key belongs to: name, plan, time zone, employee count. GET /accounts.

limit.description: Results per page, 1-500 (RotaCloud may cap it lower; the reply's total and next_offset show what is left).

offset.description: Index of the first result; pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: rotacloud_list_shifts
tools.title: List shifts
tools.description: List rota shifts in a time range: start/end times (Unix seconds), break, assigned user (null = open shift), location, role, notes, published and acknowledged state. Filter by users, locations, roles, open or published. GET /shifts.

start.description: Unix timestamp (seconds), an ISO 8601 date (2026-10-12 = 00:00 UTC) or an ISO 8601 date-time with a time zone (2026-10-12T09:00:00+01:00 or ...Z).

end.description: Unix timestamp (seconds), an ISO 8601 date (2026-10-12 = 00:00 UTC) or an ISO 8601 date-time with a time zone (2026-10-12T09:00:00+01:00 or ...Z).

users.description: Only shifts of these user ids (add 0 to include open shifts).

locations.description: Only shifts at these location ids.

roles.description: Only shifts with these role ids.

open.description: true = only open (unassigned) shifts, false = only assigned shifts.

published.description: true = only published shifts, false = only unpublished (draft) shifts.

limit.description: Results per page, 1-500 (RotaCloud may cap it lower; the reply's total and next_offset show what is left).

offset.description: Index of the first result; pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: rotacloud_create_shift
tools.title: Create shift
tools.description: WRITE: create a shift on the rota. Leave user_id out for an open shift. Unpublished by default (employees see it once published). POST /shifts.

start_time.description: Unix timestamp (seconds), an ISO 8601 date (2026-10-12 = 00:00 UTC) or an ISO 8601 date-time with a time zone (2026-10-12T09:00:00+01:00 or ...Z).

end_time.description: Unix timestamp (seconds), an ISO 8601 date (2026-10-12 = 00:00 UTC) or an ISO 8601 date-time with a time zone (2026-10-12T09:00:00+01:00 or ...Z).

user_id.description: Assigned user id; omit for an open shift.

notes.description: Shift notes shown to the employee.

tools.name: rotacloud_update_shift
tools.title: Update shift
tools.description: WRITE: change a shift's times, assignee, location, role, break, notes or published state. Only the fields you pass change. POST /shifts/{id}.

start_time.description: Unix timestamp (seconds), an ISO 8601 date (2026-10-12 = 00:00 UTC) or an ISO 8601 date-time with a time zone (2026-10-12T09:00:00+01:00 or ...Z).

end_time.description: Unix timestamp (seconds), an ISO 8601 date (2026-10-12 = 00:00 UTC) or an ISO 8601 date-time with a time zone (2026-10-12T09:00:00+01:00 or ...Z).

user_id.description: New assignee; null makes it an open shift.

tools.name: rotacloud_publish_shifts
tools.title: Publish shifts
tools.description: WRITE: publish shifts so the assigned employees see them (and get notified). POST /shifts_published.

shift_ids.description: Ids of the shifts to publish.

tools.name: rotacloud_create_leave_request
tools.title: Request leave
tools.description: WRITE: submit a leave request on behalf of an employee (sent as that user, for a manager to approve). POST /leave_requests with the User header.

user_id.description: The employee requesting leave (the request is made as this user).

leave_type_id.description: Leave type id (see rotacloud_list_leave_types; must be requestable).

message.description: Message from the employee to the manager.

tools.name: rotacloud_approve_leave_request
tools.title: Approve leave request
tools.description: WRITE: approve a pending leave request (it becomes booked leave and the employee is notified). POST /leave_requests/{id}/approve.

tools.name: rotacloud_deny_leave_request
tools.title: Deny leave request
tools.description: WRITE: deny a pending leave request (the employee is notified). POST /leave_requests/{id}/deny.
